company.name: Tovala
company.shortDescription: Tovala is a food-tech company that offers a meal service paired with a countertop smart oven.
company.description:
Tovala combines a smart oven with a fresh meal delivery service to makes dinner effortless. Tovala is a smart oven that sits on the countertop and is paired with a companion meal delivery service. The company's meal system combines an internet-connected countertop steam oven capable of multi-step cooking with meals prepared by gourmet chefs, making dinner preparation as simple as scanning a barcode, enabling busy people to get access to an effortless way to eat delicious, healthy, home-cooked meals.

The Chicago-based company was founded in 2015 and was launched in 2017.

productsAndServices.description: A weekly delivery service for fresh, pre-portioned, chef-created meals that require minimal preparation and cook in a Tovala Smart Oven in about 20 minutes or less.
productsAndServices.name: Tovala Meal Delivery Service

productsAndServices.description: A Wi-Fi-connected countertop oven with Bake, Broil, Toast, Reheat, and Air Fry modes. It uses scanned meal QR codes, grocery barcodes, or app instructions to apply programmed cooking cycles.
productsAndServices.name: Tovala Smart Oven

productsAndServices.description: A 6-in-1 Wi-Fi-connected countertop oven that adds steam cooking to Bake, Broil, Toast, Reheat, and Air Fry functions, with app and barcode-based automated cooking.
productsAndServices.name: Tovala Smart Oven Pro

productsAndServices.description: A mobile application used to connect and control Tovala ovens, scan or select cooking programs, receive cooking notifications, access recipes, and manage weekly meal orders.
productsAndServices.name: Tovala App
